questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.**

We have been

P. able to identify certain patterns in

Q. the microbiome and immune response

R. that are clearly linked to the progression and

S. severity of brain injury
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "PQRS." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as the paragraph begins with 'We have been.' So we need to use a verb after the helping verb **'have been'** and **'able'** is a verb.
 
• Sentence Q is the second sentence as the previous sentence ended with the preposition 'in'. So the next part should start with a noun or pronoun. Among the options, the noun is **'****the microbiome and immune response.'** Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'that' and creates a relation with the nouns 'the microbiome and immune response' of the previous sentence.
 
• Finally, sentence S is the last sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

We have been

P. able to identify certain patterns in

Q. the microbiome and immune response

R. that are clearly linked to the progression and

S. severity of brain injury

questions.question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

__Has__ Gita __any__ previous knowledge of __work with__ junior colleagues?
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is option 4) i.e. 'work.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'work.'
 
• We can note that the preposition **'of'** is used before the word **'work,' **which is a verb.
 
• The word that must come after 'of' should be the **object** of the preposition 'of'. Hence, a **gerund** (working) must be placed after it.
 
• A **gerund** is a verb that ends in** '-ing'** and functions as a noun or object.
 
• Therefore we need to use the gerund form of the verb 'work' which is **'working'** after the preposition 'of.'
 
• Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'working' in place of 'work' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence:__* Has Gita any previous knowledge of **working** with junior colleagues?*

• Sentence R is the first sentence as the passage begins with the noun 'The rattlesnake' and so we need to use the verb after the subject. Among the options **'knows'** is a verb. The sentence mentions the rattlesnake knows when to keep quiet.
 
• Sentence P is the second sentence as it begins with the pronoun 'it' and mentions the rattlesnake has specialised Jacobson's organs. Thus it establishes a relation with the noun of the previous sentence 'The rattlesnake'.

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

She said to me, “The charlatan will be breaking into the safe.”

options.text: She told me that the charlatan would be breaking into the safe.
She said to me that the charlatan will be breaking in the safe.

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'said to' will be changed into 'told' because reporting verb has an object, 'me.'
 
• The indirect speech will begin like 'She told me that.'
 
• Now we have to change the reported speech.
 
• According to the rules of grammar, 'will be' is in future tense and it should be changed into past tense 'would be.'
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'She told me that the charlatan would be breaking into the safe.'
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *She told me that the charlatan would be breaking into the safe.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Shalu has ordered new copies of the album.

options.text: New copies of the album have being ordered by Shalu.
New copies of the album has been ordered by Shalu.
New copies of the album has been order by Shalu.

questions.solution:

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in **'present perfect tense.'**
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + have/has + V3 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + have/has + been + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Active voice: I have written this instruction only for visitors.
 
• Passive voice: This instruction has been written by me only for visitors.
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is **'Shalu'** and the object of the given sentence is **'**new copies of the album.**'**
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• Also here, **'has ordered'** will be changed into **'have been ordered'**.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *New copies of the album have been ordered by Shalu.*
